stories.title: Canada announces retaliatory tariffs on US goods
stories.details: Canada has implemented retaliatory tariffs of up to 50% on 700 American products in response to US trade actions. This escalation follows the collapse of trade talks between the two nations, with Canadian officials emphasizing the importance of sovereignty.

stories.title: Trump announces new 50% tariff on Canadian cars, trucks and steel
stories.details: The US has imposed a 50% tariff on Canadian automotive and steel imports. This move is part of a broader trade conflict that has seen tensions rise between the two historically close partners.

stories.title: Is the Trump Treasury panicking over the level of US debt?
stories.details: Economic analysts are questioning the stability of US fiscal policy under the current administration. Concerns are mounting regarding the sustainability of national debt levels and the potential impact on global markets.

stories.title: Gold price hits three-month high amid fears over Iran war and Trump economy
stories.details: Gold prices have reached a three-month high as investors seek safe-haven assets. The surge is driven by geopolitical instability in the Middle East and uncertainty surrounding US economic policies.

stories.title: China denounces US threat of sanctions over trade with Iran
stories.details: China has vowed to take necessary measures to defend its interests following US threats to sanction entities trading with Iran. The US has targeted Iran's gold, digital assets, and tech industries.

stories.title: Household energy bills in Great Britain to hit three-year high
stories.details: Energy bills in Great Britain are set to rise by 4% from October, bringing the average annual bill to £1,723. The regulator Ofgem attributes this increase to volatile wholesale gas prices linked to the ongoing conflict in the Middle East.

stories.title: Labour’s energy bills crisis is getting worse
stories.details: Commentators argue that the government is facing a deepening energy crisis that requires greater political honesty. Analysts warn that further price hikes could occur in early 2027 if global wholesale costs remain turbulent.

stories.title: Burnham mulls insolvency law shake-up to help bring utilities under public control
stories.details: Andy Burnham is considering reforms to insolvency laws to facilitate the transition of utility companies into public ownership. This proposal comes amid broader debates about the management and affordability of essential services.

stories.title: OpenAI chip beats Nvidia's Blackwell
stories.details: OpenAI has unveiled 'Jalapeño,' an inference chip developed with Broadcom that reportedly outperforms Nvidia's Blackwell in power efficiency. The chip is designed to optimize the running of large AI models.

stories.title: Apple refreshes Mac mini and Mac Studio with new chips
stories.details: Apple has updated its desktop lineup with the new M6 chip for the Mac mini and M5 Max/Ultra chips for the Mac Studio. The M6 is Apple's first 2-nanometer design, doubling AI processing capabilities.

stories.title: UK to use Ukraine battlefield data to train AI to protect sensitive sites
stories.details: The UK government plans to utilize data gathered from the conflict in Ukraine to train AI systems. The goal is to enhance the security and protection of critical national infrastructure.

stories.title: Instagram CEO denies company hid low use of teen safety feature
stories.details: During a Meta trial, the CEO of Instagram denied allegations that the company intentionally obscured data regarding the low adoption rates of a teen safety feature. The case highlights ongoing scrutiny of social media platform safety measures.

stories.title: Meta's paid AI agent Hatch launches soon
stories.details: Meta is preparing to launch 'Hatch,' a consumer-focused AI agent with a premium subscription model. The tool is designed to integrate with various third-party services like DoorDash and Reddit.

stories.title: UK to warn citizens to stock up on food amid threat from climate crisis and hostile states
stories.details: The UK government is launching a resilience campaign advising citizens to prepare for national disasters. The initiative aims to ensure public self-sufficiency during crises, thereby freeing up resources for the most vulnerable.

stories.title: Andy Burnham poised to announce sanctions on Israeli settlements
stories.details: Andy Burnham is planning 'robust' sanctions against Israeli settlements in the West Bank. The move is a response to plans for new settler homes, which officials warn could complicate trade relations with Israel.

stories.title: Man on trial for Daphne Caruana Galizia murder claims he was framed
stories.details: In a high-profile trial in Malta, a defendant accused of the murder of journalist Daphne Caruana Galizia has claimed he was framed. The case remains a significant point of contention regarding justice and political corruption.

stories.title: US military aircraft lands in Moscow amid rumors of secret talks
stories.details: A US military aircraft made a brief, unconfirmed visit to Moscow, sparking speculation about high-level diplomatic discussions. The CIA has not confirmed if its director, John Ratcliffe, was on board.

stories.title: Dolly Parton dies aged 80
stories.details: Country music icon Dolly Parton has passed away at 80 following a battle with cancer. Celebrated for her songwriting, philanthropy, and outsize persona, she leaves behind a legacy of global superstardom.
